question: 'The Emperor's New Clothes' is a children's story by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hans Christian Andersen.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'The Emperor's New Clothes**' is a children's story by **Hans Christian Andersen.**
 
• He was a **Danish author**. 
 
• His most famous fairy tales include:
 
 
• "The Emperor's New Clothes",
 
• "The Little Mermaid",
 
• "The Nightingale",
 
• "The Steadfast Tin Soldier",
 
• "The Red Shoes",
 
• "The Princess and the Pea",
 
• "The Snow Queen",
 
• "The Ugly Duckling",
 
• "The Little Match Girl", and
 
• "Thumbelina".
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Enid Mary Blyton** was an English children's writer, whose books have been worldwide bestsellers since the 1930s, selling more than 600 million copies. 
 
• **Roald Dahl** was a British novelist, short-story writer, poet, screenwriter, and wartime fighter ace of Norwegian descent. 
 
• **Oscar Fingal O'Flahertie Wills Wilde** was an Irish poet and playwright.
